query:
SELECT
            (de.database_id IS NOT NULL AND de.trashed_at IS NULL) AS "searchable!",
            ARRAY(
                SELECT t.id FROM database_tables t WHERE t.database_id = d.id ORDER BY t.id
            ) AS "table_ids!"
        FROM databases d
        LEFT JOIN database_entities de ON de.database_id = d.id
        WHERE d.id = $1
